Episode 257. The Demon Army' Attack(13)
'What in the... Inside this main cannon's blast, how can they move so fast?'
Rondo's eyes widened.

Another incomprehensible event was unfolding. While the Demon Army, including Rondo, with nearly thirty Genesis Knights, were completely pinned down and pouring all their strength into defense, the coalition was suddenly increasing its speed of advance as if by magic.

'Even considering the transcendent power of Chiron Runcandel and the Battle Goddess Vahn, this doesn't make sense. And those two are surely protecting Jin Runcandel, using him as their eyes to move, so how in the...!'
He had thrown his decisive move by recklessly committing his main force.

But an ominous premonition that the situation was going awry from the start was creeping up on him. It wasn't just Rondo; the other Genesis Knights of the Demon Army also could not understand the situation.
They simply could not accept it.
'If the distance is closed like this, only we will be attacked...!'
Inside the barrage of Lafrarosa, no one from the Demon Army could move. So the moment they gave up the distance, it would truly be a hell until the barrage ended.

Even after committing the greatest military force in history to this 677th dimension, the Demon Army had yet to achieve any great results and had lost numerous Genesis Knights. If they were to be beaten one-sidedly again in this barrage, they might really become unable to win the war.

'I must be calm. Those bastards were definitely not moving this fast until a little while ago. That means that even if there are Genesis Knights above Genesis Knights, that speed was originally their limit. If anything, they must have been more desperate than us.'

If so, what had been added? Rondo focused and read the energy of the coalition's Genesis Knights, buried in the barrage. Besides their movements becoming bolder, there was nothing particularly different.

'It's not that one of them has suddenly awakened to another level like Chiron or Vahn. The flow of the enemy's main cannon hasn't changed either, and no matter how outstanding the enemies' technology is, it's also impossible for them to control this great power to be advantageous only to themselves.'
Magic.
Suddenly, Rondo thought that someone was using magic. Someone who had not yet been seen by his eyes on the battlefield.
And as far as Rondo knew, there was only one who could use such magic.
'...The rebels. Were the rebels helping them!'
-...It seems the remnants have finally shown themselves.
-Yes, I must find and eliminate that person from now on. So unless her movements are deeply related to this war, I will not be participating in the battle directly.
He recalled what Silyn had said a while ago.
The survivors of the 'Gray Owl,' the extremely few rebels who had survived by evading the Demon Army' pursuit until now.

If the person Silyn had gone to eliminate was a leader-class figure of the rebels, and if he was directly involved in this battlefield now, helping the coalition, it was a more than plausible explanation.
'I'm sure of it, the rebels are here! That bastard is giving information to the enemies with recording magic...!'
He had almost failed to grasp it, being crushed by the great shadow of the miracle that the coalition's Genesis Knights had shown until now.
However, there was one strange point.

'But, don't tell me Lord Silyn missed the rebel? That can't be... a monster who has never once failed in hundreds of pursuits. It's highly likely that there were more rebels besides in the dimensional passages, or that this is a person who has suddenly appeared now. Either way, all I have to do is execute him!'
Rondo took out a lump of black stone from his bosom.
A part of the heart of a completed Origin Stone; as Rondo grasped and crushed it, suddenly, a black energy began to bloom like stains all over the golden tsunami of the Plutonian Cannon.
“The ringleader of the rebels is supporting them! When the barrage subsides, we must find and eliminate that person!”
The Vamel Alliance's Genesis Knights flinched at the sight of the black stains and momentarily stopped their steps.
Chzhizhik... geugeugeuk...!
At the same time, the moment the stains bloomed, Jin confirmed the sight of the record window becoming unstable, as if it would be crushed at any moment.
“I don't know what that black energy is, but it's not particularly threatening. But as it is a strange energy that is not disarrayed even within the barrage, it could become a problem at any time.”
“A problem has already occurred, Sister Vahn. The message that the Valeria from the other dimension was sending is being cut off. It must be the influence of the black energy.”

The black energy that flowed out as the heart of the Origin Stone broke could not actually be a threat to the coalition's Genesis Knights. It only restricted the unique abilities of the rebels, like recording magic and dimensional travel, and had no killing power at all.
A newly distorted memory window appeared.
Fortunately, the message wasn't completely cut off. However, from now on, they had to advance by adding prediction to the given information to some extent.
‘Valeria.’
Before moving again, for a moment, Jin thought of the Valeria who was sending the messages.

In any world, she would have been the last survivor of the Hister. And she would have fought against the Zipfel her entire life, finally reaching the truth of the multiverse, and would have continued her desperate and arduous resistance.
Right now, she must have appeared on the battlefield, risking her life. She must have endured those harsh years and endlessly wandered the lonely world between dimensions for a moment just like this.
"Trust in me, Valeria. As I trust in you."
To increase their speed without the perfect information from the other-dimensional Valeria, they had to perform a miracle.
They had to risk their lives.

"From now on, we could die suddenly while moving. But it is worth it. The other-dimensional Valeria appeared here now because she was certain we could win, absolutely. We will advance two steps forward, and then five steps to the left!"
Right after moving that much, the recording window opened again.
This time, it was even more damaged than before. But Jin moved forward without hesitation.
"Seven steps forward, then pause for a moment, then five steps, rest for three seconds, and then one more step."
The Genesis Knight moved as one body, centered on Jin.
At that sight, Rondo couldn't help but be astonished once more.
‘They shouldn't be receiving complete records from the rebel anymore, yet they're maintaining their speed!?’

If Rondo were in Jin's shoes, he would have waited for the Plutonian Cannon to subside and then reluctantly started a disadvantageous battle. Because here, one wrong step could instantly turn the few remaining Genesis Knight to ash.

In reality, the Coalition's Genesis Knight were repeatedly facing death every second. They had never mistaken the direction or the number of steps, but there was a moment when Luna's head almost exploded because her stride was slightly off.
Thus, receiving the corrupted messages, Jin advanced about fifty more steps. The distance they had covered so far was ninety-five out of the targeted one hundred paces.

Now, only five steps remained. Despite being practically right in front of them, the Coalition and the Demon Army still couldn't see each other with their own eyes due to the barrage and the black stains.
A blackened recording window opened in front of Jin.
Now, not a single letter written in the recording window was legible. And Jin had a gut feeling. This was probably the last record he would see on this battlefield.
Although he hadn't met the other-dimensional Valeria in person, Jin felt he knew. How fiercely and desperately she must have been sending messages while avoiding the Demon Army' black energy.
Jin briefly thought of her and caressed the black recording window. It felt like touching blood-soaked paper.
"Hoo, hoo…! Brother Jin, it's five steps now. Valeria's record, hoo, seems unreadable."
"What will you do?"
Chiron and Vahn asked, breathing heavily.
At what point, in what direction, and how would they close the remaining five steps? In truth, Jin had already made his decision.
"From here, I will take the first five steps alone."
"Brother Jin?"

"If I do that, they will assume something has gone wrong with us. Naturally, they will try to launch an offensive to catch me, and their formation will naturally collapse. It will only be for a moment."
Even if the enemy's leader suddenly appeared before them, thirty Genesis Knight would not lose their reason and charge recklessly.
However, even they would have no choice but to focus entirely on killing Jin for a single moment. In the same situation, even all of the Coalition's Genesis Knight would do the same.

"Right after I step forward, withdraw all the power you were using to protect me. And then, in that single moment their formation collapses, you enter. Exactly matching the direction I advanced, just as we have done until now."

"If you do that, you will be the first to die, the moment you make a mistake, Brother Jin. The reason we followed you even though we could have died instantly just now was because there was no possibility of you dying."
"Vahn is right."

"Sister Vahn, and Father. You are both tired now. Perhaps after this battle is over and you look back on this day, you will realize it immediately. That to save me, you have no choice but to follow this method now."
Jin was already moving past the two of them, taking a step forward. Chiron and Vahn reached out to stop him but dropped their hands.
"...I understand."
"I will begin."

Unlike before, Jin leaped across the remaining four steps in a single breath. Then, just as he had predicted, the Demon Army' attacks poured down immediately, and one of the beams inflicted a serious injury, perfectly piercing his left shoulder.
‘It worked!’

But it was a success. In fact, Jin had been prepared to lose two limbs, not just suffer a penetrating wound, and the enemy had failed to inflict that much damage on him. Moreover, from the enemy's perspective, it was an attack they attempted while enduring the damage from the Plutonian Cannon.
Immediately, Chiron, Vahn, and the remaining Genesis Knight followed Jin and stormed into the enemy's formation.
"Finally, I get to see your faces up close. From now on, you will realize that the time you spent just enduring the Plutonian Cannon was a happy one."
